def evolved_p87(x, N, K, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i] = (i * i) % K -- function of position i only.
    idx = torch.arange(N, dtype=x.dtype)
    sq = idx * idx
    result = sq % K
    return result.to(x.device).to(x.dtype)
